slides.title: The corner shop
items: The first pot is on by seven. From the window seat you can watch the street wake up while the barista folds warm milk into the first flat white of the day.
Saturday papers, a pot of filter coffee and almond cake from the kitchen. There is usually room for one more chair.

slides.title: At the bar
items: A double shot of our house blend. Cocoa up front, with orange peel on the finish.
A short pour of steamed milk over espresso. Silky and full-bodied, with just a little foam.
Steeped overnight and served over ice. Dark chocolate and a light sweetness linger.
Enough for two small cups. This weekend’s roast opens with caramel and finishes with toasted hazelnut.

slides.title: Milk & honey
items: A spoonful of wildflower honey dissolves into a double espresso. Steamed milk softens the edges, leaving a little floral sweetness in the last sip.
Served in our wide ceramic cup. Oat milk brings out the toasted notes in the blend.

slides.title: House blend
items: The first sip is rounded and soft, like the edge of a square of milk chocolate.
As the cup cools, a warming nuttiness comes through. It carries especially well in a flat white.
A light citrus lift sits at the finish. Try the blend black to catch the brighter end of the roast.
